subject: biology
unit_title: The Science of Biology and Scientific Investigation

concepts.name: Scientific Method
concepts.simple_definition: The scientific method is a systematic way of investigating observations and testing hypotheses.
concepts.deep_explanation: It involves formulating a hypothesis, designing a controlled experiment, collecting variables (independent/dependent), and drawing conclusions.
concepts.real_example: Testing if plant growth depends on light by placing plants in light and dark conditions.
concepts.common_confusion: Thinking a hypothesis is a random guess. A hypothesis is a testable explanation based on prior knowledge.
concepts.simple_definition_amharic: ሳይንሳዊ ዘዴ ማለት ምልከታዎችን ለመመርመር እና መላምቶችን ለመፈተሽ የሚረዳ ስልታዊ መንገድ ነው።
concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: መላምት ማውጣትን፣ ቁጥጥር የሚደረግበት ሙከራ ማዘጋጀት፣ እና ማጠቃለያዎችን መወሰንን ያካትታል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: የብርሃን ተጽዕኖ በዕፅዋት ዕድገት ላይ ለመፈተሽ ዕፅዋትን በብርሃንና በጨለማ ቦታዎች ማስቀመጥ።
concepts.common_confusion_amharic: መላምት እንዲሁ መገመት ነው ብሎ ማሰብ። መላምት ሊፈተሽ የሚችል እውቀት ላይ የተመሠረተ ሐሳብ ነው።

concepts.name: 1.2.2Uses Of Technology In Biology The U
concepts.simple_definition: 1.2.2Uses of technology in biology The uses of technology in biology are the ways in which technological tools can be applied to solve various human problems
concepts.deep_explanation: It is the practical application of biotechnological instruments (products) in providing required human services and investigations of new biological questions
